title: Codex guide for recurSurvTests
text: modifying statistical code repository: Read docs/chat-context.md statistical motivation, method distinctions, source papers, known implementation caveats. Wang-Chang marginal recurrent gap-time survival; mean cumulative recurrent-event functions calendar time; recurrent cause-specific cumulative-incidence functions. call METRON RCIF test log-rank test. call wc_logrank() exact Zhao et al. (2020) implementation. Luo-Huang G_rho* implementation based Wang-Chang-equivalent weighted risk set. Zhao et al. supplement available original chat contains simulations/residual diagnostics source code enough formulas reconstruct exact test. full paper becomes available, add separate implementation tests. Preserve ss_rcif() cause_weighting sensitivity option. printed Equation 15 2023 paper potentially non-additive literal use. Run roxygen2::roxygenise() devtools::check() changes whenever R available. Public functions retain roxygen2 documentation references.

title: Recurrent gap-time survival and competing-risk methods
text: Recurrent-event methods often described similar language targeting different quantities. package gap-time analyses: subject ii observed gap durations Yi1,…,YimiY_{i1}, \ldots, Y_{im_i}, row input represents one gap. final row right-censored gap (status = 0); preceding rows completed events (status = 1). optional episode column specifies within-subject ordering. differs mean cumulative function, accumulates events calendar-time scale. RCIF functions also use recurrent gap times, target cause-specific incidence rather survival curve. Thus result wc_logrank() interpreted test calendar-time mean cumulative function RCIF.
code: gaps <- data.frame(   id = rep(1:4, each = 3),   episode = rep(1:3, 4),   gap = c(2, 3, 4, 1, 4, 3, 2, 2, 5, 1, 3, 4),   status = rep(c(1, 1, 0), 4),   arm = rep(c("A", "A", "B", "B"), each = 3),   cause = c("A", "B", NA, "A", "A", NA, "B", "A", NA, "B", "B", NA) )

title: Recurrent gap-time survival and competing-risk methods
text: Let mi*m_i^* number gap records used subject ii weighted-risk-set representation. gap time tt, package calculates R(t)=∑i1mi*∑jI(Yij≥t),dN(t)=∑i1mi*∑jI(Yij=t,δij=1). R(t) = \sum_i \frac{1}{m_i^*}\sum_j (Y_{ij} \geq t), \qquad dN(t) = \sum_i \frac{1}{m_i^*}\sum_j (Y_{ij}=t,\ \delta_{ij}=1). estimated hazard increment dΛ̂(t)=dN(t)/R(t)d\widehat\Lambda(t)=dN(t)/R(t) Wang-Chang-equivalent survival estimate product Ŝ(t)=∏u≤t{1−dΛ̂(u)}. \widehat S(t)=\prod_{u\leq t}\{1-d\widehat\Lambda(u)\}. code, .subject_records() validates turns long rows one record per subject, .event_grid() finds distinct completed gap times, .wrs_components() constructs subject--time risk event matrices. wc_surv() sums matrices applies product-limit update.

title: Recurrent gap-time survival and competing-risk methods
text: two subject-level groups, wc_logrank() applies Luo-Huang weighted risk-set Gρ*G_\rho^* statistic. event time contrasts observed weighted events group 1 weighted risk-set expectation, using w(t)=Ŝ(t−)ρw(t)=\widehat S(t-)^\rho. rho = 0 recurrent gap-time log-rank analogue rho = 1 Peto-Prentice analogue. variance formed subject-level martingale-style contributions, retaining within-subject dependence. Luo-Huang’s implementation, exact Zhao et al. (2020) implementation; available Zhao supplement supply enough formulas source code reconstruct latter.
code: rank_fit <- wc_logrank(gaps, group = "arm", episode = "episode", rho = 0) rank_fit[c("method", "interpretation", "G", "se", "p.value")] #> $method #> [1] "Luo-Huang WRS G_rho*" #>  #> $interpretation #> [1] "recurrent gap-time log-rank analogue" #>  #> $G #> [1] 0.1041667 #>  #> $se #> [1] 0.05311479 #>  #> $p.value #> [1] 0.0498602

what: Zhao extended rank tests and simulation checks
title: Recurrent gap-time survival and competing-risk methods
text: zhao_rank_test() separate wc_logrank() implements extended LR, GB, PP score construction Zhao et al. (2020). default variance_method = "pooled_risk" subject residuals sum exactly score covered package’s null simulation tests. "zhao_eq6" follows group-specific denominator printed Equation 6 sensitivity/reproduction implementation. distinction explicit paper’s published numerical tables regenerated exactly without original simulation software. PSG scenario treats recording 8 hours (480 minutes), staggered entry, scales chosen gap distribution target roughly 200 completed events per participant. default Z ~ U(0.75, 1.25) avoids extreme event-count dispersion paper’s U(0.1, 1.9) stress scenario.
code: zhao_rank_test(gaps, group = "arm", episode = "episode",                variance_method = "pooled_risk") #> $method #> [1] "Zhao et al. extended logrank rank test" #>  #> $test #> [1] "logrank" #>  #> $variance_method #> [1] "pooled_risk" #>  #> $alternative #> [1] "two.sided" #>  #> $group0 #> [1] "A" #>  #> $group1 #> [1] "B" #>  #> $n_subjects #> [1] 4 #>  #> $W #> [1] 0.4166667 #>  #> $variance #> [1] 0.04513889 #>  #> $se #> [1] 0.2124591 #>  #> $z #> [1] 1.961161 #>  #> $p.value #> [1] 0.0498602 #>  #> $subject_residuals #>   id group score_contribution adjustment   residual #> 1  1     A         -0.4166667 -0.4861111 0.06944444 #> 2  2     A         -0.2500000 -0.3611111 0.11111111 #> 3  3     B          0.5000000  0.3750000 0.12500000 #> 4  4     B          0.5833333  0.4722222 0.11111111 #>  #> $detail #>   time risk risk_group1  dN   dLambda   survival weight #> 1    1  4.0         2.0 1.0 0.2500000 0.77880078      1 #> 2    2  3.0         1.5 1.5 0.5000000 0.47236655      1 #> 3    3  1.5         0.5 1.0 0.6666667 0.24252107      1 #> 4    4  0.5         0.0 0.5 1.0000000 0.08921852      1 zhao_rank_simulation(n_sim = 1000, n_per_group = 100, scenario = "psg_200",                      variance_method = "pooled_risk", seed = 1)

title: Recurrent gap-time survival and competing-risk methods
text: ss_rcif() computes pooled recurrent hazard cause-specific increments. subject weight aia_i, default shared weighting uses ai/mi*a_i/m_i^* pooled cause-specific event processes. cause ll, dF̂l(t)=Ŝ(t)dGl(t)R(t),F̂l(t)=∑u≤tdF̂l(u). d\widehat F_l(t)=\widehat S(t)\, \frac{dG_l(t)}{R(t)}, \qquad \widehat F_l(t)=\sum_{u\leq t}d\widehat F_l(u). default cause_weighting = "shared" maintains pooled/cause increment additivity. "literal_eq15" reproduces printed Equation 15 denominator sensitivity option; increments can non-additive checked additivity_max_abs_dG. optional ss_rcif_equal_causes_test() integrates contrasts Fl(t)−F(t)/kF_l(t)-F(t)/k, uses Helmert contrasts, estimates covariance resampling subjects. bootstrap Wald reconstruction METRON equal-cause RCIF test, log-rank test. real analyses use substantially larger B (example, 999 ) appropriate quick example.

text: wc_surv() estimates Wang-Chang marginal recurrent gap-time survival using equivalent Luo-Huang weighted risk set. wc_logrank() implements Luo-Huang’s two-sample G_rho* statistic. rho = 0, recurrent gap-time log-rank analogue; exact Zhao et al. (2020) implementation. zhao_rank_test() separately implements Zhao et al.’s extended LR/GB/PP score construction. zhao_rank_simulation() provides paper PSG-like null-calibration scenarios. ss_rcif() estimates Sivadasan-Sankaran recurrent cause-specific cumulative incidence functions (RCIFs). ss_rcif_equal_causes_test() subject-bootstrap Wald reconstruction Sivadasan-Sankaran/METRON equal-cause RCIF test. weighted CIF contrast, log-rank test.
